description_en: Queries all regions supported by Anti-DDoS Origin Enterprise
description_zh: 查询DDoS原生防护企业版支持的所有地域信息
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-regions --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRegions

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID to query. Default value: ap-southeast-1, which indicates that the regions of cloud assets that can be protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance in the China (Hangzhou) region are queried.

To query other region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html to obtain the corresponding RegionId
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的地域ID。默认为cn-hangzhou，表示查询华东1（杭州）地域的DDoS原生防护实例支持防护的云资产的地域。

如果需要查询其他地域ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html，获取对应的**RegionId**
parameters.name: region_id

Regions.description_en: The region information of cloud assets that can be protected by Anti-DDoS Origin, including region IDs and names
Regions.description_zh: DDoS原生防护支持防护的云资产的地域信息，包含地域ID和名称等

RegionEnName.description_en: The English name of the region

RegionName.description_en: The Chinese name of the region

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。取值：
true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
